title: Filipino-Style Kare Rendang Tofu
description: A rich and creamy vegan kare rendang dish made with roasted tofu and a blend of spices, inspired by Filipino cuisine.
instructions: Place the cubed tofu on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a large pan over medium heat, sauté the chopped onion until softened.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the kare rendang paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the aroma is released.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the roasted tofu, chopped peanuts, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot over steamed rice or with some crusty bread.
